patterns.note: The hero section features an asymmetrical layout with a large, multi-line text block on the left and a prominent, full-height image on the right.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, each visually segmented by a solid, contrasting background color.
The brand logo and primary section headings utilize an extremely bold, heavy, and condensed sans-serif typeface, creating a strong, impactful visual identity.

A vibrant and diverse palette of solid, blocky colors (orange, purple, light blue, green, yellow, pink) is used for section backgrounds and highlight cards, contributing to a lively and engaging aesthetic.
The main navigation bar, including the brand logo and key action buttons, remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.

The footer is a large, distinct section with a solid light blue background and features a dramatically oversized rendition of the brand logo, serving as a powerful visual anchor at the page's conclusion.

technique_notes: A fixed header element is positioned at the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility of the brand logo and key navigation links as the user scrolls, without any transformation or shrinking.
Content is structured into full-width sections, each assigned a distinct, solid background color to visually separate and organize information, creating clear content blocks.
Card-based layouts are used extensively for presenting events and highlights, featuring images and concise text within a consistent, sharp-cornered container.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavy sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) for strong impact, paired with a readable sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp for most elements, with subtle rounding on some interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density, with airy hero and footer sections contrasting with tighter grids for event cards and highlights.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and almost playful use of typography, particularly the extremely heavy and oversized sans-serif for the brand logo and section titles. This, combined with the vibrant, blocky color segmentation and the massive logo in the footer, gives it a unique institutional yet modern and engaging character that avoids generic marketing aesthetics.
